comment: Frozen field-store key vectors (nested buckets, GAP-22; S-1 ruled document-first 2026-09-29). Every hex string was written by hand from the grammar in store/fieldkey.go's header, not produced by the code under test: owner = [slot:2][database id:8][bucket id:8][0x07] || 0x50 || the key with each 0x00 written 0x00 0xFF || 0x00 0x00; store prefix = owner || field id (2 bytes BE); element = store prefix || inner byte || remainder; fifo remainder = position (8 bytes BE); heap remainder = ^(uint64(priority) ^ 1<<63) (8 bytes BE) || 0x50 || entry id || 0x00 0x00; keyed remainder = 0x50 || key || 0x00 0x00; state key = store prefix || 0x05; state value = head, tail, next, count, 8 bytes BE each. slot 0x0abc, database id 1, bucket id 0x0102 throughout (the database id was inserted by U2 of the entry-ring build, which moved every key to the 19-byte prefix).
generator: none, deliberately: TestFieldStoreKeyEncodingFrozen has no regenerate mode, as storage/keys_test.go:TestSlotFunctionIsFrozen has none. A frozen file the test can regenerate is not frozen; a changed row re-points every field-store element ever written.

l3_elements.comment: post p1, fifo field 1, element at position 5, heap field 2, priority 10, entry f
